name: Floodway Underpass
description: Concrete, sodium light, wet gravel, and water moving where it should not.

name: Pump House Three
description: A locked municipal pump station with old warning signs, new scratches, and a basement that should be dry.

name: Bus Loop at Rain
description: A low bus loop where puddles gather under shelter glass and every timetable is damp.

name: Old Switching Station
description: A brick utility building behind chain-link fence, full of dead panels and one humming copper trunk.

name: Old Civic Archive
description: A records office with rolling shelves, water stains, and maps that have been corrected too many times.

name: Ellice Rooming House
description: A sagging house cut into too many rooms, with mail slots for tenants no one remembers.

name: Root Cellar Door
description: A narrow cellar entrance under the kitchen stairs, sealed with old locks and newer apologies.

name: Willow Shelterbelt
description: A strip of trees at the city's edge where tracks enter but do not always leave.

name: Edge Bus Shelter
description: A glass bus shelter near open fields, warm with human breath and old fast-food wrappers.

name: Grain Elevator Foundation
description: The concrete remains of an elevator, half swallowed by grass and old hunger stories.

name: Boarded Mall
description: A half-empty shopping centre with bright islands of commerce in a sea of shuttered gates.

name: Food Court Below
description: An impossible lower food court where every sign is familiar but no logo is quite right.

name: Service Corridor Cathedral
description: A service corridor stretched impossibly tall, where loading doors stand like chapels to things returned.

name: Survey Marker Zero
description: A brass survey marker set into cracked pavement where no official survey says it should be.
